form.addSubtitle: The room shows on the guest site as soon as it is saved.
form.sectionInfoHint: Shown on the room list and on the room's page.
form.name: Room name
form.typeNewHint: Name of the new room type. If it matches one already in use (ignoring case and spaces), that one is used.
form.typeExists: “{{type}}” already exists: the room goes into that type.
form.locationHint: Area, then province/city after the last comma. The part after the last comma is the home page's "destination".
form.sectionPriceHint: What a guest pays per night, before coupons. A room under maintenance takes no new bookings.
form.maintenanceHint: Off, the room is on sale; “available” or “booked” follows from its bookings.
form.sectionCapacityHint: The most guests one booking can bring for this room.
form.amenitiesSection: Listed on the room's page; with none, the Amenities block is not shown.
form.amenitiesHint: {{count}} / {{max}} amenities. Type one and press Enter to add it.

errors.type: Choose or add a room type.
errors.price: The price per night must be above 0.
errors.capacity: Guests must be a whole number from 1.

photos.title: Photos
photos.hint: Drag to reorder; the first photo (gold frame) is the cover. JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB each; photos are turned upright, stripped of location data and compressed.
photos.label: Photos of the room
photos.tooMany: A room takes at most {{max}} photos; the extra ones were skipped.
photos.removeMessage: Delete this photo from the room? This cannot be undone.
photos.removeCoverMessage: Delete the cover? The next photo becomes the cover. This cannot be undone.
photos.uploadFailed: The photo could not be uploaded.
photos.failed: That did not work for this photo.
photos.savedAtOnce: A saved room's photos are saved as soon as they are uploaded, moved or deleted.
